papers.title: Forecast Collapse in Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.what: Names a failure mode where time-series foundation models produce nearly flat, poorly ranked forecasts on low-predictability targets, traces it to low predictability plus per-series objectives, and proposes CalibRank, which nearly triples cross-sectional correlation on Finance1K while holding forecast amplitude near the target.

papers.title: MobileMem: Learning from a Year of Mobile Experiences
papers.what: Builds a year-scale benchmark for on-device agent memory by synthesising temporally consistent multimodal trajectories from user-app sessions, scoring multi-hop and temporal reasoning, knowledge updating, and implicit preference inference rather than short-horizon retrieval.
papers.builds_on: Memory Mechanisms Survey (2026, BDY3HUCV); GLOBEM (2023, ICD9EG8Q); MindScape (2024, K4PR34NU)

papers.title: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning
papers.what: Splits the transformer into a shared feed-forward Memory holding knowledge vectors and several self-attention Reasoners that query it iteratively, matching a 7B baseline with 62.6 percent of its training data and delivering close to a 4x inference speedup at 35B.
papers.builds_on: Attention Is All You Need (2017, PHB9VRVM); DeepSeek-V3 (2024, 2JCKA7GI); ST-MoE (2022, WIGLUNFZ)

papers.title: Second Thought: Reasoning in Parallel as LLM Agents Act and Observe
papers.what: Fills the idle window while a ReAct agent waits on the environment by forking four auxiliary reasoning branches and merging them when the observation arrives, cutting main-thread decoding by up to 43 percent with no training and no significant Pass@1 loss.
